a.lede: Muse is topping the app store charts and adding users at a rapid clip, while Meta ramps up the personal AI agent's promotion across its own apps and beyond.
a.title: Meta is putting its muscle behind Muse as the AI app takes off

b.lede: Meta says it will focus on bringing its full technology stack, including Muse, Meta Business Agent, Muse API, Muse Code, and more to businesses and developers.
b.title: Meta launches enterprise AI platform, hires MongoDB CEO to lead new initiative
